coverage: Native immutable policies reject invalid inputs and deny unknown labels, classes, bits and cross-policy identities; query-only capabilities cannot create policies or assign subjects
Subjects survive Environment spawn, fork and exec; management handles are close-on-exec

Stock selinux_check_access allows add/find/list grants, returns EACCES for denied grants on three repeated AVC lookup cycles, and rejects unknown context/class/permission
Process-label writes, permissive writes, policy loading, writable status mmap and mprotect upgrade are rejected
Kernel tests exercise per-open access transactions, directory records, policy-scoped filesystem opens, Binder cross-policy confinement and relabel rejection
Unmodified libbinder retains its two object transfer/lifetime cycles, unlink, death callback, clear completion and DEAD_OBJECT regression checks
18 Bionic cases including both static and dynamic three-process Binder object probes
limitations: Service authorization query foundation only; stock servicemanager add/find and Android framework startup are not tested
No Android binary policy, VFS MAC, Unix credential enforcement, transitions, MLS categories, permissive mode or live policy updates; security.selinux xattrs remain opaque metadata
Binder policy confinement does not implement SELinux Binder call/transfer permission classes or security-context transaction records
Existing Binder FD transfer, weak promotion, one-way/nested calls and automatic worker-pool limits remain; endpoint lifetime still follows the open-file description
